data.body: **[P1] Preserve fatal failures across the async invocation boundary.** Although `createPlugins` rethrows `VirtualMachineError` and `ThreadDeath`, this call runs inside `DurableExecutor`'s `CompletableFuture.supplyAsync`. The future captures those throwables, and the unchanged failure branch converts them into a normal durable failure; notably, an injected `ThreadDeath` is suppressed and its worker may be reused. After unwrapping the handler failure in `DurableExecutor`, finalize any published plugins and rethrow these fatal causes instead of building a failure output. Add end-to-end tests through `DurableExecutor` for fatal factory and hook failures.
